description: This file is the main source code for a Flutter TV application. It contains the app's entry point, widget tree setup, focus management for TV remote navigation, and screen routing including a login screen and a placeholder home screen.

classes.name: ActivateIntent
classes.description: A custom Intent class used to trigger activation (select/activate) events via DPAD_CENTER/ENTER/SPACE on TV remote.

classes.name: TvFocusable
classes.description: A focusable widget that visually highlights when focused and invokes a callback upon activation, facilitating TV remote navigation UX.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the login screen with focusable text fields and a login button, designed for TV focus navigation.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A stateless placeholder widget representing the home screen.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that runs the app with MyApp as the root widget.

methods.name: MyApp.build
methods.description: Builds the root MaterialApp with theme and route setup.

methods.name: _LoginScreenState.build
methods.description: Build method constructing the login UI with focus and input handling for TV navigation.

methods.name: _goHome
methods.description: Navigates to the HomeScreen, replacing the current route.
